result.question: What taxes and levies does my business have to pay?

claims.text: The business must register with the relevant tax authority and obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number (Tax ID) for compliance with tax obligations.
The Tax ID obtained must be stated on all returns, notices, correspondence and documents submitted for tax compliance, and on documents prepared in respect of transactions.
The business must notify the tax authority within 30 days of any change in its particulars, including name, trading name, location of business, telephone numbers or email address.
As an employer with three employees, the business must file a PAYE return for all emoluments paid to its employees by 31 January each year, disclosing gross emoluments and allowances.
The business must register for Value Added Tax and charge VAT on taxable supplies, as VAT is imposed on all taxable supplies in Nigeria subject to exemptions in Part IV of Chapter Eight.
The business must submit a VAT return to the Service in the prescribed form on or before the 21st day of the following month.

"Tax Authority" means the Nigeria Revenue Service, or the Revenue Authority of a State or the Federal Capital Territory in Nigeria

"beneficial owner" means a person who has ownership, control, rights, indirect benefit or beneficial interest over shares or clients, or over income, goods, services or assets subject to tax, or on whose behalf a transaction is carried out

"partnership" means an association, or a body of two or more persons who have agreed to combine their rights, powers, property, labour or skill for the purpose of carrying on a trade or business and sharing the profit
"employment" includes any appointment or office, whether public or otherwise, for which remuneration is payable

"small business" means a business that earns gross turnover of N50,000,000 or less per annum with total fixed assets less than N250,000,000, provided that any business providing professional services shall not be classified as a small business
"small company" a business that earns gross turnover of N100,000,000 or less per annum with total fixed assets not exceeding N250,000,000.
"registration" means action or process of registering or of being registered for tax purposes in accordance with this Act

"supply" means any transaction where the whole property in the goods is transferred or where the agreement expressly contemplates that this will happen and in particular includes the sale and delivery of goods or services used outside the business, the letting out of goods on hire or leasing and any disposal of goods or furnishing of services

queries.sql: SELECT section_id, act_id, section_no, heading, tier, text FROM taxmap.sections WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%small business%' OR lower(heading) LIKE '%small business%' LIMIT 40
SELECT section_id, act_id, section_no, heading, tier, text FROM taxmap.sections WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%small company%' OR lower(heading) LIKE '%small company%' LIMIT 40
